title: Love it. Perfect soap dispenser.
text: Love it. Perfect soap dispenser.. We decided to use a separate soap dispenser at the kitchen sink rather than the one that's built into the counter, since it's much easier to fill and you can see when it needs to be filled. This is the perfect dispenser - large enough, easy to use, and stylish-looking on the countertop.
